label: Financial Records
description: Minimal starter vocabulary for a financial-records tenant. Deliberately small and generic: it exists to prove the platform is aimed by configuration, not to guess at a client's retention schedule.
_editing: This file is DATA. Edit it with a text editor — no code changes needed.
document_types = what a document IS. requirements = the checklist line items it CLOSES.
claim_types + claim_rules = what a document ASSERTS and which requirement that opens.
Seeding is additive (INSERT OR IGNORE) — re-running never overwrites edits made in the admin UI.
_deliberately_omitted: Retention PERIODS (7 years, permanent, ...). We do not know this client's schedule and a wrong number in a compliance tool is worse than no number. Retention is a per-document field, not a vocabulary row, and is parked in backlog.md.
Jurisdiction- or framework-specific checklists (SOX, GAAP/IFRS, IRS publication cites). Those are a real deliverable, not a starter guess.
Expiry / renewal defaults per document type — document_types has no renewal columns today (renewal lives per document), so any default here would be fiction.
A large claim taxonomy. Only the two claims that unambiguously open a named document are seeded.

document_types.name: Bank Statement
document_types.description: Periodic statement from a financial institution.

document_types.name: Bank Reconciliation
document_types.description: Reconciliation of a bank statement to the ledger.

document_types.name: General Ledger Export
document_types.description: Ledger detail for a fiscal period.

document_types.name: Journal Entry Support
document_types.description: Backup documentation for a manual journal entry.

document_types.name: Financial Statement
document_types.description: Balance sheet, income statement or cash-flow statement.

document_types.name: Tax Return
document_types.description: Filed return for a tax period.

document_types.name: Fixed Asset Register
document_types.description: Asset listing with cost and accumulated depreciation.

document_types.name: External Audit Report
document_types.description: Report issued by an outside auditor.

document_types.name: Insurance Policy
document_types.description: Policy document with coverage and term.
Information return issued to a contractor.

claim_types.name: Externally Audited Period
claim_types.description: The document states the period was audited by an outside firm — the audit report itself then has to be on file.

claim_types.name: Reportable Contractor Payment
claim_types.description: The document records a payment to a contractor that triggers information reporting — the counterparty W-9 has to be on file.
